title: DummyCritFix
description: A mod that fixes the critical damage multiplier display issue in the Target Dummy mod.
body:
This mod fixes a series of critical damage multiplier display issues in the Target Dummy mod based on NeoForge's critical hit system API.

The fixed issues include:

Damage numbers with critical damage multipliers could not be displayed on entities other than the dummy.

The critical damage multiplier applied in practice could not be correctly calculated.

For additive damage from other mods, the critical damage multiplier displayed on damage numbers could be incorrectly attributed to other damage sources, such as Apotheosis's elemental damage.
